meta_title: Flux76 — app and web studio from the Netherlands
meta_desc: Flux76 is an independent studio in the Netherlands that designs and builds iOS apps, web apps and websites you stay in control of.
og_desc: iOS apps, web apps and websites you stay in control of. Tell us about your project.
hero_h1: Apps and websites you stay in control of.
hero_lede: Flux76 is an independent studio from the Netherlands. We design and build iOS apps, web apps and websites for entrepreneurs and organisations, with the same care we put into our own products.
hero_note: Shown here: DiscVault, our own app for iPhone, iPad and the web, with a demo collection.
services_lead: Four kinds of work. Each one is backed by a product we designed, built and run ourselves.
svc_1_p: Apps for iPhone and iPad that feel at home on the device, and keep working without a server where that fits.
svc_2_p: Web applications that install like an app, work on any screen and can run on your own server.
svc_2_proof: As in our self-hosted web apps
svc_3_p: Fast, clear websites that you can keep up to date yourself, from your phone if you like.
svc_4_p: A second pair of eyes on architecture, data ownership and running software yourself with Docker.
work_lead: Everything below was designed and built by us, and we still maintain it. It shows what we can build for you.
dv_p: A catalogue for physical 4K UHD, Blu-ray and DVD collections. One product in two forms: a standalone iPhone and iPad app that needs no server, and a complete platform you run on your own infrastructure.
dv_shows: native iOS, a desktop-first web platform and self-hosting working together in one product.
mk_p: Marktkraam.site gives market traders their own website. Customers see at home what is on the stall today, and the trader updates the offers from a phone.
mk_shows: software that people without technical knowledge keep up to date themselves.
apps_h: Smaller web apps, open on GitHub
apps_lead: Each of these runs on your own server with Docker, so the data stays with you.
ms_p: Turns a Mealie week menu into a full basket at Albert Heijn, Picnic or Jumbo.
dm_p: An installable neighbourhood map that shows which houses are happy to receive Halloween visitors.
pp_p: Works out what a 3D print really costs, tracks filament stock and turns orders into invoices.

process_h2: From a first conversation to software you keep
process_lead: No thick proposals and no surprises. Four steps, and you know where you stand at each one.
step_1_p: You tell us what you want to solve. We ask questions and say honestly whether we are the right fit.
step_2_p: A concrete plan: what we build, on which platform, what it costs and when it is ready.
step_3_p: We build in short rounds. You see working software early and can steer along the way.
step_4_p: We deliver, document and stay available for maintenance, or hand everything over so you can run it yourself.
about_h2: A small studio that builds what it uses
about_p1: Flux76 is an independent software studio in the Netherlands. We make our own products and take on work for others, and both get the same attention.
about_p2: You talk directly to the person who builds your software. No account managers, no handovers.
val_1_p: Each product solves a clear problem without piling on distractions.
val_2_p: We use only the data a product needs, and make clear what happens to it and who controls it.
val_3_p: Native, web or self-hosted: chosen for the job, not for the trend.
val_4_p: Clear upgrade paths and software you can keep using for years.
contact_lead: Send us an email with a few lines about what you have in mind. A rough idea is enough to start a conversation.
contact_q1: What do you want to build?
contact_q3: When would you like it to be ready?
contact_support: Using one of our apps and need help? The same address works for support.
